component.name: CrealityPrint
component.summary: Slice models and control Creality 3D printers

description.p: This is a community package of CrealityPrint, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream AppImage unmodified and uses the same app id as upstream's own Flatpak build.

Creality Print is a self-developed FDM slicing software produced by Shenzhen Creality 3D Technology Co., Ltd. It's a practical and easy-to-use tool that can help you remote control and monitor your 3D printer and help print directly from your computer.

ul.li: Slices STL, 3MF, OBJ and AMF models with ready-made profiles for Creality printers and filaments.
Sends jobs to printers on your network and monitors them, including the camera view.
Multi-plate projects, supports, painting and calibration tools.

description.p: Permissions follow upstream's own Flatpak build: network, all devices (USB printers and serial ports), your home directory, removable media, and UDisks for ejecting an SD card or USB stick.
